result.finding: Two volumes configured in docker-compose.yml for the Oracle database service: one named volume for data persistence and one bind mount for initialization scripts. The application container (photoalbum-java-app) has no volumes — photos are stored as BLOBs in Oracle DB.
evidence: docker-compose.yml oracle-db service: named volume 'oracle_data' mapped to /opt/oracle/oradata for database persistence
docker-compose.yml oracle-db service: bind mount ./oracle-init:/container-entrypoint-initdb.d for DB initialization scripts
photoalbum-java-app service has no volumes configured — photos stored as Oracle BLOB data
values: oracle_data:/opt/oracle/oradata (named volume, Oracle DB data persistence)
No application volumes — stateless app container, photos persisted in Oracle DB
